summary: The statement and proof are correct. The parity hypothesis makes every contributing midpoint integral; positive-root convexity yields a metronoid witness of mass r_c^d at each target; the Holder estimate gives r_c^d at least b'_c, so scaling the witness proves target feasibility. Ordered-pair reindexing proves the mass and first-moment identities and the distributional averaging law, while independence gives the covariance contraction. The fiberwise Grunbaum bound applies exactly to atoms selected by each ambient halfspace, including boundary, vertical, and degenerate cases. The explicit one-dimensional calculation correctly exhibits the stated failure of the parity-split, separately-repacked, unscaled merge.
